077 · the globe lamps' night light and the leaf gloss

Glint, 2026-10-30, Unity 6000.6.2f1. Latch's probe Assets/Scenes/probe-planting077.unity (git-ignored), opened in batch and never saved; every light, material copy and mask texture is in memory (unity/Assets/Suborned/Editor/OldTown/Swap/Glint077.cs). The swap's play camera with our play look (OldTownPlayLook), zoom 14 at 38°. Night is our night: light.json night as HarbourDistrict's NightPhase built it (Latch's read-only copy, probe-leafshader077/night.json: moon, trilight, night sky, night reflection cube, the night grade) plus lens.json's night floor (ambient and moon 0.42, shadow 0.6). The lens lift (0.002 linear offset) is left out. The swap has no night lamps of its own yet, so the four globe pools are the only pools on the square, apart from one street-kind stand-in at the old DK_PlazaSphereLamp.

Lamp values (light.json night.lamps.kinds "globe", night.emissive globeOpal, palette night.lampGlobe): a point light, #fff1d8, intensity 7, range 5.8 m, 2.31 m above each GlobeLamp_TB base, no shadows, no cookie, night only (off by day and at evening, like the street kind). Opal emission = linear(#fff1d2) × level: day 0.06, evening 0.06, night 2.5. The testbed's 28 cd works out to about 9 in URP, because three.js divides diffuse by π and URP doesn't. At 9 the paving between the islands goes near white where the pools overlap, so I used 7. The testbed's opal is 3.5; at that level the bloom spreads wider than the pool, so I used 2.5.
Gloss call: tame it. Leaf mask scale k 0.49 → 0.80, petal k 0.64 → 0.80 (smoothness = 1 − k × ORM.g: leaves about 0.78 → 0.64, petals 0.64 → 0.55). This keeps the testbed's dark glossy leaf. The sharp white sun glints become a soft sheen, by day in both looks, and the wet-white point-light glints at night are gone. k 1.0 (C) goes matte and loses the gloss.
Cost: four unshadowed point lights at night only. PC_Renderer is Forward+, so they add no SetPass, no draws, no shadow maps and no variant (additional lights are already on). They reach 51, 66, 56 and 50 renderers within 5.8 m. The gloss change costs nothing: the same mask, size and format, only different bytes. The opal is one material property.
